metadata.description: Skills for deciding things before you build them.

plugins.name: link
plugins.description: Every skill in this marketplace behind one install. Ships nothing itself — it pulls in the individual skill plugins.

plugins.name: link-design-pitch
plugins.description: Survey ten visual directions rendered with your real content and stop for your choice, then apply the chosen one to every surface. Two skills, installed together.

plugins.name: link-skill-authoring
plugins.description: Criteria a skill must meet to hold up. Two rules, plus a contract line and six questions each skill settles for itself. Stops before deciding what a skill promises.

plugins.name: link-skill-packer
plugins.description: Pack a skill into a zip a coworker can install, for places where git is out of reach. Checks the failures that break a skill with no error message, then stops for your confirmation before writing it.
